name: register_bridge_preflight_v1
purpose: NONCAUSAL feasibility measurement (Codex round 27, repaired per audit #38 and round 28), NOT staircase advancement. Is the explicit-legend episode state (legend + registry record, zero delay) linearly decodable (rank <= 8 standardized ridge, dual form) from frozen Qwen3-1.7B-Base residuals at the record's tag span, transferring to held-out entities, templates and permutations, above input-embedding, categorical and PAIRED context-destroyed controls and a balanced entity-clustered label-shuffle null? Every entity is crossed with every state. A PASS = linear state decodability for an explicit legend lookup; it is not a code-level or causal bridge and says nothing about the constructed register. One CPU process at a time; runs after the writer rung.
templates: Registry: the private value for {entity} is
Record: {entity} has been assigned the value
Ledger entry: for {entity} the stored value reads
Note: the value on file for {entity} is

permutation_banks.balanced: Latin squares: every tag occurs once for every state within each bank
permutation_banks.pidx_rule: (e + j*4) mod 8 (independent of state and template)

prompt.clause_order: shuffled once per (entity, state, template) cell and shared by the paired arms
prompt.destroyed: legend pairing k -> pi[sigma[k]] with sigma a derangement drawn once per cell; the record tag then denotes sigma^-1(state) != state; same clause order, permutation, record and token multiset

representation.span: final occurrence of the record tag (never legend copies); tokenization identity asserted
representation.legend_occurrence_reference: mean residual at the same tag's legend clause, middle listed layer (reported as a positive reference, not gated)

decoder.type: standardized ridge scores XW+b -> R^8 (rank <= 8), dual form
decoder.inner: entity folds over the two other groups select (layer, lambda)
decoder.eval: held-out entities x held-out templates x held-out permutations; the destroyed arm reuses the intact fold decoders

controls: mean input embedding over the identical tag span
categorical linear baseline: tag identity, template, span position, token length
paired context-destroyed prompt scored with the intact decoders (accuracy vs original state and following of the destroyed-legend state)
balanced entity-clustered label-shuffle null: one state permutation per training entity applied to all its rows; 200 fits at the selected (layer, lambda); all scores saved

gates.control_advantage_rule: entitywise maximum over the three controls, paired difference bootstrapped over entities

statuses: PREFLIGHT PASS — EXPLICIT-LEGEND STATE LINEARLY DECODABLE
PREFLIGHT FAIL — NO QUALIFYING EXPLICIT-LEGEND STATE DECODER

licenses.pass: frozen Qwen's tested source span contains a linearly accessible, presentation-transferring explicit-legend state signal, warranting the required dialogue about moving register_bridge_v1 earlier
licenses.partial: an engineering bridge from lexical/context features, not an abstract native state
licenses.fail: this rank-eight zero-delay source-span route is not a supported bridge; it does not say Qwen lacks state
